acceptance_predicates.description: Setup and provider catalog enumerate the pinned OpenRouter profile and supported model.
OPENROUTER_API_KEY is represented only by a redacted reference digest and never persisted as a secret.
Provider/model selection rejects unsupported or stale models before provider contact.
Missing development credentials, signatures, and key services produce visible warnings without blocking setup or replay; production remains fail-closed.
Default CLI output is human-readable and --json remains machine-readable.

definition_of_done: Exact origin/main implementation passes focused provider, setup, schema, redaction, and negative tests.
Independent receipt records exact head and test evidence.

inputs.description: ASB setup and provider catalog contract on exact protected main.
Pinned OpenRouter profile and credential resolver.

outputs.description: Secret-free OpenRouter setup and catalog receipt.

gates.description: Tests run against exact origin/main head.
